name: Morse.MatrixInner.innerProductSpace
why: The project's inner product is Re tr(Aᴴ B), Milnor's (and the blind) Re tr(A Bᴴ): different order of factors but equal, Re tr(Aᴴ B) = Re tr(B Aᴴ) = Re conj tr(A Bᴴ). The normed-space parts are the same (Frobenius norm, Mathlib's ℝ-module), so the two InnerProductSpace structures are equal (proved by congr on the structure).
